_comment: Failure messages the backend puts on a streaming Complete, and the ErrorCode the frontend must derive from each. The backend derives a failed Complete's code from its message and the frontend classifies by keyword when no code is present, so rewording a message changes what the UI shows. Both suites assert against this file.
